Name: Simpler Hair
Author: mellodiro
Description:
- keeps all hairstyles in their original hairstyle
- brightens each hair to more accurately represent the hair color the player chooses
- simplifies the art style
- adds more hairstyles !!

please note you can only have either the main file or the optional file- having both won't work!

main file:
- all original hairstyles + 8 new ones (and more to come!)
special thanks to [url=https://rumikos.tumblr.com/]rumikos[/url]/[url=https://harvestdew.tumblr.com/]harvestdew[/url] @ tumblr who let me base hair 59 after their farmer, kiki, and also thanks to MysticBooka for their wonderful feedback leading to better updates for the mod ^^!


optional file:
- only original hairstyles (for those who want the simpler hair mod, but want to play with friends who play with vanilla hair)

i am only one person, and i felt i was unable to properly take the time to test the hairs :( let me know if there's any missing pixels or any awkward placement/shapes


thank u love u bye
